items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method. Invoked after ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader), ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) and MessageSourceAware, if applicable.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

items.source: This interface can also be implemented if an object needs access to file resources, i.e. wants to call getResource, wants to publish an application event, or requires access to the MessageSource. However, it is preferable to implement the more specific ResourceLoaderAware, ApplicationEventPublisherAware or MessageSourceAware interface in such a specific scenario.
items.translation: 如果对象需要访问文件资源（即希望调用getResource）、发布应用程序事件或需要访问 MessageSource，也可以实现此接口。然而，在如此具体的场景中，最好实现更具体的ResourceLoaderAware、ApplicationEventPublisherAware或MessageSourceAware接口。

items.source: Note that file resource dependencies can also be exposed as bean properties of type Resource, populated via Strings with automatic type conversion by the bean factory. This removes the need for implementing any callback interface just for the purpose of accessing a specific file resource.
items.translation: 请注意，文件资源依赖也可以作为类型为 Resource 的 Bean 属性暴露出来，这些属性通过字符串由 Bean 工厂进行自动类型转换填充。这消除了仅为访问特定文件资源而实现任何回调接口的需要。

items.source: ApplicationObjectSupport is a convenience base class for application objects, implementing this interface.
items.translation: ApplicationObjectSupport 是一个方便的应用对象基类，实现了此接口。

items.source: For a list of all bean lifecycle methods, see the BeanFactory javadocs.
items.translation: 有关所有 Bean 生命周期方法的列表，请参阅 BeanFactory javadocs。

items.source:
Implementing this interface makes sense for example when an object
requires access to a set of collaborating beans. Note that configuration
via bean references is preferable to implementing this interface just
for bean lookup purposes.
items.translation: 实现此接口在以下情况是有意义的：例如，当对象需要访问一组协作的 Bean 时。请注意，通过 Bean 引用进行配置优于仅为了查找 Bean 而实现此接口。

items.source: ApplicationContextException - in case of context initialization errors
items.translation: ApplicationContextException - 在上下文初始化错误时

items.source: BeansException - if thrown by application context methods
items.translation: BeansException - 如果由应用程序上下文方法抛出

items.source: Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in.
items.translation: 设置此对象运行的 ApplicationContext。

items.translation: applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象
